prompt_text: Use the attached original-source contact sheet of six objects in reading order; retain the exact row mapping. Return a clean transparent atlas of exactly six equal columns × six equal rows, with columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Use the attached center-dot guide only to center each subject; never reproduce dots. Preserve material, palette, dimensions, details, and source identity. CAMERA AND SHAPE RULES OVERRIDE ANY ISOMETRIC APPEARANCE IN THE SOURCE: each named view is a true axis-aligned principal projection, with no diagonal camera, three-quarter view, foreshortening, or copied source angle. ROW 1 wooden bridge: TOP shows full deck-plank footprint from straight above; BOTTOM only underside beams. FRONT and REAR are broad horizontal deck-edge elevations with supports beneath, no visible top deck plane; RIGHT and LEFT are narrow end elevations of the deck/supports, no top plane. ROW 2 barred gate: FRONT/REAR show full upright gate face; RIGHT/LEFT show thin gate depth; TOP/BOTTOM along Z are only thin horizontal top/bottom rail edges, never the upright picket face. ROW 3 stone stairs: FRONT elevation shows step profile; TOP direct overhead rectangular footprint with treads; RIGHT/LEFT proper side elevations; BOTTOM is a single rectangular flat stone underside slab, no stairs visible; REAR is solid vertical back/riser wall, not upper tread faces. ROW 4 L-shaped wall: TOP direct overhead L footprint. FRONT and REAR each show only the straight-on broad elevation of one wall wing; RIGHT and LEFT each show the perpendicular wing's broad elevation, without a diagonal corner camera showing both wings at once; BOTTOM shows underside footprint. ROW 5 square stone pillar: FRONT/REAR flat single-face elevations; RIGHT/LEFT adjacent single-face elevations, exactly edge-on without showing a second face; TOP/BOTTOM square cap/base only. ROW 6 broken barricade: keep coherent source-based projections. For all objects one complete isolated item per cell, no cell crossing, no duplicate, no added ornament, transparent background with no labels, grid, borders, shadows, or scenery. Keep the same fixed object pose across all views. Unseen surfaces are inferred, not recovered pixels.
